description: This file defines a test common class for GStreamer-based media player tests, including mock objects, setup functions, and internal state management for testing the GstGenericPlayer component.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerTestCommon
classes.description: A test fixture class providing setup, mock objects, and utility functions for testing the GstGenericPlayer component.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Simulates the setup of a source element in the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Simulates the setup of a generic GStreamer element.

methods.name: triggerDeepElementAdded
methods.description: Simulates the event of a deep element being added to the pipeline.

methods.name: setPipelineState
methods.description: Sets the state of the GStreamer pipeline to the specified state.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreated
methods.description: Prepares the environment for creating a GstGenericPlayer instance.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeDestroyed
methods.description: Cleans up resources after GstGenericPlayer instance destruction.

methods.name: expectShutdown
methods.description: Sets expectations for shutdown procedures during tests.

methods.name: expectStop
methods.description: Sets expectations for stopping the pipeline during tests.

methods.name: executeTaskWhenEnqueued
methods.description: Executes a task when it is enqueued in the test environment.

methods.name: initFactories
methods.description: Initializes mock factories used in testing.

methods.name: expectMakePlaybin
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating the GStreamer playbin element.

methods.name: expectSetFlags
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting flags on GStreamer elements.

methods.name: expectSetFlagsWithNativeAudio
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting flags related to native audio handling.

methods.name: expectSetSignalCallbacks
methods.description: Sets expectations for signal callback setup.

methods.name: expectSetUri
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting the URI on the pipeline.

methods.name: expectCheckPlaySink
methods.description: Sets expectations for verifying the play sink.

methods.name: expectSetMessageCallback
methods.description: Sets expectations for message callback setup.
